name: Semein
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Semein is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ in Luke. He is the son of Josek and the father of Mattitja, belonging to the part of the genealogy covering the period between the return from exile and the time of Jesus. Little else is known about him beyond his place in Jesus' family tree.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Semein is listed in Luke's genealogy as one of Jesus' ancestors through Joseph's line. He is placed between Josek (father) and Mattitja (son).

keyEvents.title: Part of the Davidic lineage
keyEvents.description: Semein belongs to the Davidic lineage that leads from King David through Nathan and down to Jesus, as described by Luke.

keyEvents.title: God's faithfulness through the generations
keyEvents.description: Semein's place in the genealogy testifies to God's faithfulness in fulfilling His promises of a Messiah from David's line through many generations.

keyEvents.title: The connection between Zerubbabel and Jesus
keyEvents.description: Semein is part of the important chain of generations that connects Zerubbabel, who led the people back from exile, with Jesus Christ.
